name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Surface Preparation
intent: Low-pressure wash, scuff sand, caulk siding-to-trim joints, dust cleanup. No end-seal (construction task). No power washing.
doctrine: NC prep for fiber cement siding. Low-pressure wash ONLY (power washing prohibited). Scuff sand on factory-primed and ColorPlus surfaces for adhesion. Caulk siding-to-trim joints only (NOT butt joints on lap siding). No end-seal (construction task). Profile and texture modifiers apply to scuff sand.
